connections.label: PostgreSQL via pg; TLS for shared Supabase

implementation_qualifications: JWKS is fetched and cached only in asymmetric mode; legacy HS256 verifies locally with a backend secret.
TLS describes shared Supabase; disposable local PostgreSQL configurations can use plaintext loopback connections.
The database pg_cron job is optional per environment. No running database or job state was freshly checked.
Database connections groups pg.Pool and borrowed clients. It is not a repository or business-rule layer.
HTTP role gates and service/policy ownership, assignment and transition checks have distinct responsibilities.
Services call the application notification writer with their existing transaction client; SQL triggers remain in PostgreSQL.

Registration/withdrawal, final confirmation and stock-shortfall notifications use migration 019 triggers. Cancellation uses the application writer; expiry notices are written by the SQL expiry function.
The repository lists Sprint 3 administratively Active and Sprint 4 Future. This 5 November audit is outside the configured Sprint 3 dates and supplies no sprint-end delivery credit.
